hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bgh\s+pr\s+merge\b'; then if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z_])ALLOW_AUTO_MERGE=1\b'; then echo 'BLOCKED: gh pr merge requires explicit user approval per AGENTS.md. Ask the user first, then prefix the command with ALLOW_AUTO_MERGE=1.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0

input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; dir="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/web-v2"; [ -d "$dir" ] || dir="web-v2"; out=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && node scripts/validate-shop.mjs 2>&1); printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'SHOP VALIDATION FAILED' && printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs '{decision:"block", reason:("Shop data validator failed — fix these before ending the turn:\n"+.)}'; exit 0
